Create a privilege review map and production bridge for a litigation discovery status briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one privilege review map and production bridge in the first viewport.

Situation: Matter: Atlas v. Meridian. Custodians C1-C5, review batches B12/B13, privilege team, redaction desk, production set P4, clawback log.
Current state: B12 review 86%, B13 review 41% red, C3 privilege hit-rate 18% amber, redaction desk backlog 740 docs, P4 production target 12,000 docs, clawback log 9 items.
Timeline: 09:00 review pull, 10:00 privilege sample, 11:20 redaction queue, 13:00 partner review, 16:00 production cutoff, 18:00 opposing counsel update.
Sources: S1 review platform, S2 privilege sample, S3 redaction queue, S4 partner notes, S5 production tracker, S6 clawback log.

Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. Add a client email snapshot preview beside the appendix.
